name: gmail
author: John P. Giatropoulos
description: Granular Gmail widgets — inbox, message view, compose, and search.

widgets.name: GmailInbox
widgets.description: Displays inbox emails with unread indicators. Click to select and publish emailSelected events.

widgets.name: GmailMessageView
widgets.description: Displays full email content. Listens for emailSelected events to load the selected email.

widgets.name: GmailCompose
widgets.description: Compose and send emails. Listens for emailSelected to pre-fill reply-to fields.

widgets.name: GmailSearch
widgets.description: Search emails with custom queries. Click results to publish emailSelected events.

widgets.name: GmailWidget
widgets.description: Search and read emails via the Gmail MCP provider.
